newsitem.title: USA: Bay Meadows says will consider offer.
newsitem.headline: Bay Meadows says will consider offer.

text.p: Bay Meadows Operating Co said it would consider, and consult with shareholders of California Jockey Club on, a $22 per share offer for the company from Starwood Capital Group.

"The Bay Meadows board will carefully consider the offer made by Starwood Capital and I am sure that the board of Cal Jockey will do the same," Jack Liebau, chief executive of Bay Meadows said in a statement.
Bay Meadows operates the Bay Meadows Racecourse near San Francisco, and its shares are paired with shares of California Jockey, a real estate investment trust, as a single unit.
Since August, the two companies have been embroiled in a battle for control of the two operations. Monday, Starwood Capital, a private real estate investment firm, offered to acquire the operations.
